proposal.summary: GitLab versions from 4.1 up to 16.1.5, 16.2 up to 16.2.5, and 16.3 up to 16.3.1 contain an issue that allows creation of a URL which redirects to a different project.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab: all versions starting from 4.1 before 16.1.5; all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.

AV.quote: it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.

UI.quote: it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.

S.quote: it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm whether unauthenticated users can create such redirect URLs and reproduce the issue; if confirmed, develop and deploy a patch that validates/normalizes redirect targets to prevent cross-project redirects and backport the fix to all affected branches.

evidence_quotes.quote: An issue has been discovered in GitLab affecting all versions starting from 4.1 before 16.1.5, all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5, all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
it was possible to create a URL that would redirect to a different project.
